title: fix(scenarios): scorer and card defects from the 18.6.0 gallery refresh (dataset coverage, over-gating, delete floor, card wording)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91tYCagMT6JaQ6YA5YqnWwi)_
Part of #36558 (all seven items land here; the card's done-when, a re-run on 18.6.0, is the eval seat's and is the remainder: items 4, 5 and 7 are card wording, which only a fresh build can show working).
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到什么变化:用户无感;只有评测席位跑场景卡时,打分器的三处判法和四张卡的提问措辞变了。
- 为什么做:属于「评测度量:场景卡与评测轮次」专题,修掉画廊刷新里评分器误判和卡片措辞把模型带偏的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某次评测把一个回答或构建判得偏严或偏松,只影响评测分数,不碰线上功能,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

One item per row; every conclusion is against `origin/main` at the merge base of this branch.

| Item | What changed |
|:--|:--|
| 1. withheld-field decline | `scenario-run-grade.ts`: on a `withheld` truth, the asker and field-absence wordings are read with the reply's dataset-coverage sentences left out (`datasetCoverage`). A sentence is one when it names a dataset or report, by the word or by the name/label of a dataset a `query_dataset` answer of the turn served, and nothing in it binds to the asker (you, your role, permission, access, visible, hidden, ...). "The Approved Leave dataset can't group by medical note" is no decline; "... can't show medical notes to you: the field is hidden from your role" still is. The #36323 and #36352 readings are unchanged (their pins pass untouched). |
| 2. over-gating | `gradeAgentActions` adds `action:OBJECT.NAME->not-confirm-gated` for every card action marked `confirm: false`: it fails when the build sets `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` (or does not declare the action). The build prompt's action header now says an unmarked action runs with no confirmation gate, so the build is told what it is graded on. |
| 3. delete floor | `gradePersonaGrants` reads a granted `delete` against the platform's owner-only delete floor (`deleteFloorReading`), from the platform code: `member_default`'s `owner_only_deletes` (`created_by == current_user.id`, `plugin-security/src/platform-ownership-policies.ts`) is lifted only by `SharingService.checkDelete` answering `allow` (`plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`): ownership, Modify All or a write depth of `org`, and only where the object's org-wide default is not public and it has an `owner_id` (`checkDelete` abstains otherwise, and an abstain keeps the floor, Modify All included). The runner loads seed rows as the admin, so no persona created one; the row's owner is the runner's own `rowOwner`, moved to `src/row-owner.ts` so the scorer reads the same answer without importing the runner (re-exported from `runner/prompts.ts`, runner surface unchanged). A row only an authored delete/all row policy, a `controlled_by_parent` master's gate, or a declared route action (`via`, or the confirm-gated action for a waiting write) could admit is not measured. leave_balances `hr_officer` with `allowDelete` and no Modify All now fails `persona-grant:hr_officer:leave_request:delete`, naming LR-0100 and LR-0003. |
| 4. service_desk `log_ticket` | The action summary now says it assigns the ticket to the signed-in agent who logs it and opens it (status open). |
| 5. leave_balances `sick_by_medical_note` | The ask (en and zh) counts by what the medical note itself says, not by whether a medical certificate is attached. |
| 6. order_to_cash `overpay_invoice` | **Accepted `HOOK_ABORTED`; the seed is unchanged.** `refusalMeets` now lets a declared `VALIDATION_FAILED` be met by `HOOK_ABORTED` at a 4xx status. Reason: the card measures that the app's own rule refuses an overpayment, and `HOOK_ABORTED` is exactly that (the ledger's undeclared hook refusal, answered at the status the hook chose, else 400; a sandbox fault is served 5xx and stays unmet). Ruling A on #31999 item 9 already accepts a hook's *declared* refusal; an undeclared one is the same app rule without a code. The seed route cannot keep the card measuring what it claims: invoices are seeded with their stored `amount_paid` / `balance`, which already count each loaded payment, and the card's questions read those totals; no seed in which a rule comparing a payment with its invoice's balance accepts every loaded payment and refuses the overpayment exists short of seeding invoices without those totals, which changes what the questions measure. |
| 7. `automation.record-triggered-flow` | **An explicit flow ask on the two cards; the posture line is kept.** requisition_to_receipt: "the requisition becomes ordered, set by a record-triggered flow on the purchase order when its status changes to sent". travel_expense: "a record-triggered flow on the approval step then moves the claim on (once the manager approves, the claim becomes manager-approved and its Finance step opens)". Both cards' "prefer declarative" line now lists record-triggered flows (en and zh). The posture line is right: it is about a value derived from other fields, which a flow leaves empty on every loaded row; both asks are runtime events whose seeded rows already carry their status, so they do not contradict it. asset_lifecycle and service_desk carry the tag and already ask for flows. |

Also: `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` and `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` describe the three new readings; one `@objectstack/scenarios` patch changeset (the card JSONs ship in the package library).

## Tests

All on head `a2c2e31cdb`, package `@objectstack/scenarios`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` and the package's own build, through the shared verify lock.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 42 passed (42), Tests 1324 passed (1324).
- New pins: item 1 in `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts` (new describe), item 2 as an `ACTION_DEGRADATIONS` row in `test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`, item 3 in a new describe there (leave_balances card, seven cases), item 6 in `test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts` beside the ruling-A cases.
- **Forced test changes** (an item flipped an existing reading):
  - Item 2 adds one check per `confirm: false` action: control-card totals 26/37/32 become 28/39/34 (`scenario-cards.test.ts`), the rich build's action count 5 becomes 6 and the missing-action list gains `set_task_status->not-confirm-gated` (`scenario-tags.test.ts`).
  - Item 3: the crm fixture builds (`test/export/fixture.ts`, `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`) and the crm completed build (`scenario-cards.test.ts`) give the sdr `writeScope: 'org'` on contact, which lifts the floor for its deletes of admin-owned contacts without unmasking `email` the way Modify All would; the completed-build case gains a degrade that drops it. The project card's `task` is a `controlled_by_parent` detail, so `persona-grant:contractor:task:delete` reads not measured on a granting set in three `scenario-tags.test.ts` cases, and the waiting-confirmation case's figures move accordingly. No case was deleted.
- The R3 ACTING roster in `mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts` needed no change: no operation ask was reworded (item 5 rewords a question).

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed tested behaviour, unit tests import src/, so no dist leg; each mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- Item 1, the dataset-coverage filter made a no-op: `scenario-run-grade.test.ts` Tests 2 failed / 86 passed (the two ⛔ cases).
- Item 2, the not-gated check made to pass whenever declared: `scenario-tags.test.ts` Tests 1 failed / 109 passed (`set_task_status->not-confirm-gated fails on its own defect`).
- Item 3, the floor reading switched off: `scenario-tags.test.ts` + `scenario-cards.test.ts` Tests 9 failed / 122 passed.
- Item 6, `HOOK_ABORTED` taken out of `refusalMeets`: `mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts` Tests 1 failed / 61 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The update half of the same floor (`owner_only_writes`) is not modelled by `persona-grant:*:update`; the card scoped item 3 to delete. An update floor reading would follow `checkEdit` (an edit share and a queue also lift it, a `public_read_write` default opens it). Noted, not filed: no run has shown it.
- A `delete` the card refuses `PERMISSION_DENIED` is still judged by the set alone; no open card declares one, so the floor is not read on that leg.
- A `controlled_by_parent` detail's delete is not measured rather than modelled through its master's update gate; on the control cards that is `task` and `invoice_line`.
- The build prompt does not state the delete floor; per `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` the persona's role must imply its grants (hr_officer is "organization-wide ... who deletes withdrawn leave requests").
- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json` records the card's sha256 at build time; the card text changed, so a re-export reads the provenance as against the earlier card. Nothing pins that hash.

## Verification

First read (by risk):
1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts` `deleteFloorReading`: the floor model, the one reading of platform code in this PR.
2. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` `declinesWithheld` / `datasetCoverage`: what counts as binding to the asker.
3. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-operation-grade.ts` `refusalMeets`: the `HOOK_ABORTED` widening.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts` shows the describe "a delete the set grants, read against the platform's owner-only delete floor" with seven passing cases.

<details><summary>Local gate subset (dispatch-gates --commands derivation at a2c2e31cdb: 70 commands; 69 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE`: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's dist; only the scenarios closure is built here). Left to CI.
- Every other derived command exited 0, among them `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:published-files`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset`.
- `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean exit 0 (origin/main merges cleanly, 0 PR heads share a file).
- Everything else CI runs (the repo-wide lint, Test Core including the `repo` project, Build Core, the type-check lanes) is CI's.

</details>
